source_lines_after.text: Assume AC. Let $N\ge2$ and let $f:(X,x_0)\to(Y,y_0)$ be a based continuous map between nonempty path-connected simply connected CW complexes. Suppose $f_*:H_i(X;\mathbb Z)\to H_i(Y;\mathbb Z)$ is an isomorphism for $0\le i<N$ and a surjection for $i=N$. Then $f_*:\pi_i(X,x_0)\to\pi_i(Y,y_0)$ is an isomorphism for $1\le i<N$ and a surjection for $i=N$. No conclusion about $\pi_{N+1}$ or homotopy equivalence of the spaces is included.
